title.en: An Act to Change the Name of the Faraon Elementary School At Sagay, Occidental Negros, to Gil Lopez Elementary School.

text.en:
The elementary school of the municipality of Sagay, Occidental Negros, at present known as
Faraon Elementary School, shall hereafter be known as Gil Lopez Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, August 5, 1935.
